description: This pie chart illustrates four key conceptual components, divided into four equal slices that each represent exactly 25% of the total circular area. The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit numerical percentage labels; instead, descriptive text and icons are placed directly inside each segment, with corresponding external text boxes bordered in matching colors. All four slices are visually emphasized by being slightly offset from the center, creating a white cross-shaped gap between them. The top-left slice is yellow, contains the internal label "Complexity" alongside a ladder icon, and is paired with an external box reading "Uncrushable." The top-right slice is light blue, features the internal label "Instance" with a shield and checkmark icon, and is accompanied by an external box reading "Unhackable." The bottom-left slice is red, displays the internal label "Scalable Oversight" with a clipboard icon, and links to an external box reading "Auto-verifiable." Finally, the bottom-right slice is green, shows the internal label "Coverage" with a globe and gears icon, and is associated with an external box reading "General." Because all segments are identical in size, there is no descending or ascending order based on proportion.
